product_overview: A Next.js frontend for ForgeGraph that provides user authentication, a visual graph authoring experience, run monitoring, operational pages for prompts/credentials/approvals/memory, and admin/analytics surfaces. The app surfaces backend-driven execution state and management workflows to end users.
core_goals: Author, configure, validate, and save visual workflow graphs
Start, inspect, and monitor execution runs and view detailed traces and memory activity
Manage prompts, credentials, human approvals, and stored memory observations
Authenticate and access protected app surfaces and onboarding flows
View analytics and admin screens to monitor usage, billing, and organization settings

features.name: Authentication and Session Flows
features.description: Allow users to register, sign in, and access protected pages; unauthenticated attempts are redirected to authentication entry points.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill email and password fields on login or registration forms -> Submit credentials and wait for navigation into the authenticated app -> See app navigation and protected pages available

Navigate to /login -> Fill email and password fields on login or registration forms -> Submit credentials and wait for navigation into the authenticated app -> See app navigation and protected pages available
Navigate to /login -> Fill email and password fields with incorrect credentials -> Submit credentials -> See validation error indicating invalid credentials

features.name: Graph Authoring Experience
features.description: Provide a visual editor for creating and editing workflow graphs, configuring nodes, running validation overlays, and using wizards to scaffold content.
user_flows: Navigate to /graphs -> Open a graph from the list -> Add nodes -> Connect edges between nodes -> Open node configuration forms -> Edit node settings and graph metadata -> Trigger validation -> See validation overlay indicating pass -> Save graph

Navigate to /graphs -> Open a graph from the list -> Add a node with incomplete configuration -> Trigger validation -> See validation errors in overlay -> Open node configuration forms -> Fix node configuration -> Trigger validation -> See validation overlay indicating pass -> Save graph

features.name: Run Monitoring and Execution Feedback
features.description: List past and running executions, surface run statuses, traces, and memory activity, and let users inspect execution details.
user_flows: Navigate to /runs -> Browse run list to find an execution of interest -> Select a run to view its detailed trace and status -> Observe run statuses, traces, and memory activity panels
Navigate to /runs -> Browse run list -> Select a run to view detail -> Refresh or revisit the run detail to observe updated status and trace entries

features.name: Prompt, Credential, Approval, and Memory Management
features.description: Operational pages for browsing, inspecting, creating, and updating prompts, credentials, approvals, and stored memory observations.
user_flows: Navigate to /prompts -> Browse list of prompts -> Open a prompt detail -> Edit prompt content and submit -> See updated prompt in the list
Navigate to /credentials -> Browse credential list -> Open credential detail -> Update credential metadata and submit -> See updated credential in the list
Navigate to /approvals -> Browse pending approvals -> Open an approval detail -> Submit an approval decision -> See the approval removed from the pending list
Navigate to /memory -> Browse memory observations -> Open an observation detail -> Update tags or metadata and save -> See updated observation in the list

features.name: Analytics, Onboarding, and Admin Surfaces
features.description: Dashboards and admin interfaces for onboarding progress, LLM and memory analytics, billing, organization, SSO, audit logs, marketplace, and operations.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding -> Review onboarding milestones and complete a milestone -> See onboarding progress update
Navigate to /analytics/llm -> Review LLM usage charts and metrics -> Navigate to /analytics/memory -> Review memory usage charts and metrics
Navigate to /admin -> Navigate to /admin/billing -> Review billing and plan information
Navigate to /admin -> Navigate to /admin/organization -> Inspect organization settings and members
Navigate to /admin -> Navigate to /admin/audit-logs -> Review recent audit entries
Navigate to /admin -> Navigate to /admin/marketplace -> Inspect marketplace packages and administration controls
Navigate to /admin -> Navigate to /admin/operations -> Inspect operational controls and diagnostics
Navigate to /admin -> Navigate to /admin/sso -> Inspect SSO configuration and status
Navigate to /admin -> Navigate to /admin/help -> Review admin support and help resources

routes.description: Marketing landing page and entry point to login or app flows.
Graph editor page for creating and editing workflow graphs.
Detailed run trace and status page.
Memory browser and observation management page.

features.name: Authentication and Session Flows
features.description: Register, login, protected routing, and callback handling for authenticated app access.
user_interactions: Fill email and password fields on login or registration forms.
Submit credentials and wait for navigation into the authenticated app.
Attempt to open a protected page and get redirected when unauthenticated.
Return from OAuth or SSO callback routes and complete login flow.

features.name: Graph Authoring Experience
features.description: Visual workflow graph editing, node configuration, validation overlays, and wizard-assisted authoring.
user_interactions: Open the graph list and navigate into a graph editor.
Add nodes, connect edges, and open node configuration forms.
Edit graph metadata and node settings.
Trigger validation and inspect overlay or status feedback.
Use the agent wizard and quick-add tools to scaffold graph content.

features.name: Run Monitoring and Execution Feedback
features.description: Start-facing run pages, run history, trace detail, and event-driven status views.
user_interactions: Open the run list to inspect previous executions.
Navigate to a specific run detail page.
Observe run statuses, traces, and memory activity panels.
Refresh or revisit run detail after backend status changes.

features.name: Prompt, Credential, Approval, and Memory Management
features.description: Operational pages for prompts, credentials, human approvals, and stored memory observations.
user_interactions: Open prompt, credential, approval, or memory pages from the app navigation.
Browse lists, inspect detail panels, and submit relevant forms.
Review pending approvals and memory observations.

features.name: Analytics, Onboarding, and Admin Surfaces
features.description: Dashboards and administration pages for analytics, onboarding progress, billing, organization, SSO, audit logs, operations, and marketplace views.
user_interactions: Open onboarding and analytics dashboards after login.
Navigate through admin sections and inspect organization, billing, SSO, audit, and marketplace pages.
Review charts, tables, and status cards driven by backend data.

known_limitations.issue: Most meaningful routes depend on authenticated backend APIs and seeded data.
known_limitations.impact: Frontend-only tests need mocks, while end-to-end tests need backend and engine support to exercise real flows.

known_limitations.issue: The graph editor is interaction-heavy and sensitive to API and validation responses.
known_limitations.impact: High-confidence coverage requires integration or E2E tests in addition to simple component rendering tests.
